title: Kraft add-on
description: The .kraft/addon.json in an add-on's directory: its name, version and what it needs from the instance. Its components sit beside it in fixed places: library.yaml, chains/, skills/ and profiles.yaml.

name.description: The same name as this add-on's entry in collection.json. References to its contents use it as a prefix (release:ship), unless the operator installs the add-on under another name with --as.

version.description: SemVer 2.0.0 without build metadata: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release suffix (1.4.0, 2.0.0-rc.1). Installed instances update only when it changes; a lower value by SemVer precedence is reviewed as a downgrade.

requires.description: What the add-on needs from the instance. Checked at validate, install, update and load. Unknown keys are refused: a requirement this Kraft cannot check must not pass as met.

kraft.description: MAJOR or MAJOR.MINOR. "2.4" means at least 2.4.0 and below 3.0.0; "2" means any 2.x.

harnesses.description: Harness ids the instance's harnesses.yaml must define. An add-on task's harness: and fallback[].harness may name only these.

profiles.description: Instance agent profiles the add-on's tasks select by bare name.

addons.description: The one add-on this add-on builds on, as <addon>@<collection>, mapped to the range of its versions accepted, in the form of kraft: "3.1" means at least 3.1.0 and below 4.0.0. The add-on may not name itself.

identifier.description: A Kraft name: lowercase ASCII letter first, then letters, digits, _ or -; at most 64 characters.
